description: One public TikTok video by URL from the video page's embedded data: caption, hashtags, creation date, duration, size, cover image, region, language, ad flag, exact play, like, comment, share, save and repost counts, the author (ID, username, nickname, verified, follower and like totals) and the sound. Keyword, hashtag and profile video lists are not available anonymously. Deleted or private videos return 404.
